Two advanced platforms — the Motus AZ+ for painless hair removal and laser facials, and the PicoLO picosecond laser for pigment and tattoo removal — operated by trained laser techs with medical oversight. Safe across the full range of skin tones. Book Your Visit Explore Services Advanced laser treatments for clearer, healthier skin. Every laser service begins with a consultation to confirm you're a candidate and map the right plan. 01 Painless Laser Hair Removal The Motus AZ+'s cooled Moveo handpiece feels like a warm massage, not a series of zaps — with 80–95% permanent reduction over a series. Memberships from $99/month. Explore 02 Moveo GLO Laser Facial Our most advanced laser facial — the Moveo tip protects the surface of your skin while delivering more energy where spots, redness, and collagen live. $300, or 3 for $750. Explore 03 Signature Laser Facial Our entry-level laser facial — targeted correction of a few individual spots or vessels, finished with a full-face Laser Genesis for collagen and glow. $175 per session. Explore 05 PicoToning Laser Facial Picosecond pulses break up pigment, even tone, and stimulate collagen — safe across all skin tones, with no peeling or downtime. $275 per session. Explore 06 Tattoo Removal PicoLO picosecond technology shatters ink into finer fragments than older lasers — fewer sessions, faster clearance, safe for all skin tones. Explore 06 Leg Vein Treatment Targeted laser energy collapses visible spider veins so your body clears them — from a single small cluster to both legs in one visit. Explore The Technology Motus AZ+ and PicoLO, side by side. The Motus AZ+ pairs two wavelengths — Alexandrite 755nm and Nd:YAG 1064nm — with Moveo handpiece technology that delivers continuous, cooled energy. It's what makes our hair removal genuinely comfortable and our Signature Laser Facial downtime-free, across the full range of skin tones. The PicoLO works on a different clock entirely: picosecond pulses, trillionths of a second long, that shatter pigment and tattoo ink into fragments fine enough for the body to clear efficiently — with minimal heat left behind in the skin. Precision that feels effortless — at the speed of light. Good To Know Before any laser visit. Consultations come first. We confirm candidacy, review your skin and history, and set realistic expectations — tattoo removal consultations are complimentary. Sun and lasers don't mix. Plan to avoid direct sun exposure and self-tanner for two weeks before treatment. Some clients should wait. Laser treatments aren't appropriate during pregnancy or breastfeeding, with active skin infections, within six months of Accutane use, or with certain photosensitizing conditions — we'll walk through it together. Prefer a monthly rhythm? Dedicated laser hair removal memberships run $99–$199 per month — see the Laser Hair Removal Membership page. See what the right laser can do.
